compliance.description: Technical checks of log collection, sealing and backups.
compliance.confirmBackupBody: You confirm that arcilogger.toml, secret.key and the Caddy CA folder (with its private key) were copied to encrypted offline media kept apart from the backups (secrets.json optional; BACKUP.md section 3). The confirmation is written to the audit log with the configuration's current SHA-256.
compliance.loadFailed: The check results could not be read
compliance.backupConfirmed: The confirmation of the configuration copy was written to the audit log.
